queries: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_ratio FROM film WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99 AND rental_rate IS NOT NULL AND rental_duration IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_mean FROM per_rating WHERE avg_ratio IS NOT NULL) SELECT p.rating, p.avg_ratio, p.avg_ratio - o.overall_mean AS diff_above_mean FROM per_rating p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_mean IS NOT NULL AND p.avg_ratio > o.overall_mean ORDER BY p.rating

assumptions.assumption: A film qualifies when replacement_cost >= 20.99, so films costing exactly 20.99 are included. The request does not say whether the cutoff is inclusive.
Rows with a NULL rating are not excluded. If any exist, they form their own group and count in the mean of per-rating averages.
The ratio is computed per film as rental_rate / rental_duration. Those per-film ratios are averaged within each rating, and the per-rating averages are then averaged with equal weight.

alternatives.interpretation: The cutoff is exclusive: only films with replacement_cost strictly greater than 20.99 qualify.

assumptions.assumption: 'Replacement-cost cutoff of 20.99' means films qualify when replacement_cost is strictly greater than 20.99 (not >=).
Ratings are grouped as stored in film.rating; films with NULL rating (if any) would form their own group and be included in the mean of per-rating averages only if present.

alternatives.interpretation: Qualifying films are those with replacement_cost at or above 20.99 (>= instead of >).

assumptions.assumption: 'Replacement-cost cutoff of 20.99' means qualifying films have replacement_cost strictly greater than 20.99 (not >=); the request does not say which side of the cutoff qualifies.

Films with NULL rating are excluded from grouping, since rating is a grouping class with 5 levels; rental_rate and rental_duration are NOT NULL so the ratio is always defined (rental_duration is 3-7, no division by zero).
